event.title: Houthis Declare Maritime Embargo Against Saudi Arabia Amid Ongoing Conflict
event.canonical_title: Houthis Declare Maritime Embargo Against Saudi Arabia Amid Ongoing Conflict
event.summary: Yemen's Iranian-backed Houthi rebels have announced a maritime embargo against Saudi Arabia, effective immediately. This decision is described as retaliation for a blockade on Yemen and a recent attack on Sanaa International Airport. A military spokesman emphasized that the embargo is based on the principle of 'an eye for an eye'.

timeline.title: Houthis Impose Maritime Embargo on Saudi Arabia in Response to Blockade
timeline.summary: The Houthis have announced an immediate maritime embargo on Saudi Arabia, citing it as a reaction to the Saudi blockade of Yemeni ports and airports. In response, the Saudi-led coalition has threatened to use force against any ships affected by the embargo, indicating a potential escalation in the ongoing conflict.
